# Grantor without use — D-009
Synthetic principals only. `mgr-comms` has `grant_use` for `telegram.send` in the VP-approved pool and has no `use` grant. `grant_issue` to `sup-crier` succeeds and writes `g-director-42`, with issuer, recipient, scope, `origin: director_grant`, policy revision and readback. The recipient's configured approval policy is evaluated independently.
The same `mgr-comms` principal calling `telegram.send` returns `403 tool_not_granted` and writes one denial audit row. No credential value is present; `profile_ref` is a reference only.
Expected audit sequence: `grant_issued`, then `tool_call_denied` with `cause: tool_not_granted`.
A cross-profile context transfer does not change this invariant. The target receives only an explicitly authorized imported reference and resolves a new policy snapshot. It does not inherit the sender's `use`, `grant_use`, authority, policy owner, credentials, or learned state. Hermes owns learning and recall; CHD carries protected references only.
